question: Why do the desktop widgets render as white rounded rectangles and the Settings page garble, while the wallpaper, icons, menu bar and text draw correctly?

device_observation.symptom: desktop widgets white with no content; Settings page garbled and repaints slowly; GUI otherwise correct
device_observation.first_seen: present in the earliest desktop photographs, including Recovery c5f88b1175af9478cddcd2a7998b88915fcf592d7b556fc9eb656ce2703b4337 whose boot page reported gpu offers=0 (the Metal plugin never loaded)
latest_page_rows: SWAP calls=292 ok=292 rej=0 | gpu offers=292 done=292
GPU last: subs=0 cache_ms=299 MB=4706 | all: subs=18 ms=3365 max_us=29550
device_observation.evidence_quality: device-observed photographs and boot-page counters; no instrumented capture of the compositor's surface descriptions

experiments.hypothesis: dpu-scanout=2 direct scanout presents the compositor surface incorrectly
experiments.result: widgets still white; the boot page became visible again, which separates the two effects

experiments.hypothesis: wallpaper-freeze=1 holds Poster's frame and hides later layers
UBWC / CB compressed surfaces are read as linear pixels
the Metal plugin lets Poster processes keep 10-bit XR10 surfaces
experiments.change: supportsExtendedXR10Formats answered 0 for every process; plugin rebuilt and re-signed as CDHash 4490c306601dd01d9c0539f71c86b43687a89dbc, trust bundle 46689a1a6c81c149b45045cb874f36c1fb6a494654d44d187abf06c590a74772
experiments.result: widgets still white and Settings still garbled

experiments.hypothesis: the twelve signed-text fixups never reach the shared cache
experiments.result: parsed=12 applied=12, the sRGB/BGRA8 policy is applied

follow_up: The surviving 0f9ac357 upload receipts show handshake failures. Its image attribution above remains unverified. A confirmed boot of Recovery 5fd0a19c carries the same Metal addon and shows FIX parsed=12 applied=12. See ../peripheral-bringup-20261116/report.json.
conclusion: The reference's XR10 stripes and this tablet's white widgets are visually distinct. The available logs leave both the compositor output and the widget-rendering path under investigation.
next_actions: Remove /private/var/ngpu/addons/NativeAdrenoMetal.bundle, the publish file and the daemon from Data and boot once without the Metal plugin, to test whether the white regions need the plugin at all.
Print the submitted swap surface's pixel format, bytes per element and plane count on the boot page.
Compare against a reference-port photograph of the same iPadOS build's desktop to see whether its widgets draw.
Check whether lite=1 (package/BootWatchdogPolicy.c) disables any process that renders widget content.
